title: Order book
description: A canvas price ladder: asks above the spread row, bids below, with depth bars, price grouping, flashes on changed levels, large order highlight and a cumulative hover summary. Hundreds of updates a second cost one draw per frame.

basic.title: Basic
basic.description: book takes a snapshot ([price, size] levels in any order). The rows fill the height; the spread row shows the mid (or lastPrice) with the spread in basis points, the bar at the bottom the bid/ask imbalance. Hover a row: average price, sum and notional from the best level.

live.title: High-frequency stream
live.description: A simulated matching engine sends 10 to 200 messages a second through the ref handle: applyDeltas for the book, setLastPrice for the trades. Changed levels flash (side color when they grow, gray when they shrink); each message costs a few array writes, the ladder draws once per frame and stops off screen.

grouping.title: Price grouping
grouping.description: grouping aggregates the levels by a price step: bids rounded down, asks up, so buckets never cross. The price decimals follow the step. depthBars draws cumulative or per-level bars.

large-orders.title: Large orders
large-orders.description: Levels reaching largeOrderThreshold are tinted, marked and bold. A click (or Enter) on a row fires onLevelClick with its cumulative values, e.g. to fill an order form.

modes.title: Sides
modes.description: mode shows both sides, or only the bids or the asks: one side then fills the whole height. The arrow keys move through the rows, Enter picks one.

terminal.title: Market terminal
terminal.description: One simulated feed drives three widgets, the ladder, the depth chart and the trade tape, like one exchange WebSocket. Click a level: its price becomes a limit line on the depth chart. React only re-renders the header, four times a second.

dark.title: Dark terminal
dark.description: The ladder reads the CSS variables of its container: a terminal palette set on a wrapper (or the dark site theme). A monospace font aligns the digits; total="quote" shows the cumulative notional in USDT, depthBars="level" one bar per level.

compact.title: Compact (mobile)
compact.description: A phone panel: two columns, 17 px rows, no imbalance bar, as many rows as the height allows (or set rows). Below 260 px wide the texts shrink and the third column is dropped.

red-up.title: Red up, green down
red-up.description: colorConvention="red-up": red bids, green asks (mainland China, Japan, Korea). The flashes, depth bars, imbalance bar and last price arrow follow.

data.title: Order book
data.pickedBid: Bid {{price}}: {{size}} BTC, {{sum}} BTC down to here
data.pickedAsk: Ask {{price}}: {{size}} BTC, {{sum}} BTC up to here
data.pickHint: Click a level to pick its price.

OrderBookProps.book: Book to draw, applied when the object changes (stream updates through the ref)
OrderBookProps.lastPrice: Price of the spread row, colored by its last move; the mid price when omitted
OrderBookProps.onHover: Hovered row with its cumulative values (null when the pointer leaves)
OrderBookProps.onLevelClick: Click, tap or Enter on a row (e.g. to fill an order form)
OrderBookProps.ref: Imperative handle: setBook, applyDeltas, setLastPrice, getInstance

OrderBookHandle.applyDeltas: Applies updates (size 0 removes a level), drawn once at the next frame
OrderBookHandle.setLastPrice: Price of the spread row (the mid price when null)

OrderBookOptions.mode: Sides shown: asks above the spread row and bids below, or one side
OrderBookOptions.grouping: Price step aggregating the levels (bids rounded down, asks up); 0 shows the raw levels
OrderBookOptions.rows: Rows per side; as many as the height allows when omitted
OrderBookOptions.rowHeight: Height of a row, in pixels
OrderBookOptions.depthBars: Bars behind the rows: cumulative total, size of the level, or none
OrderBookOptions.total: The total column cumulates sizes (base) or notional values (quote)
OrderBookOptions.flash: Flashes the size of the levels that changed (side color when it grows, gray when it shrinks)
OrderBookOptions.flashDuration: Duration of a flash, in ms
OrderBookOptions.largeOrderThreshold: Rows whose size reaches this value are highlighted (walls)
OrderBookOptions.header: Header row with the column names
OrderBookOptions.spreadRow: Spread row between the sides: last or mid price, spread and basis points
OrderBookOptions.imbalance: Bid/ask imbalance bar at the bottom
OrderBookOptions.tooltip: Hover summary: average price, cumulative size and notional up to the hovered row
OrderBookOptions.labels: Overrides of the built-in texts, which follow locale (English, Chinese, Japanese and French built in)

OrderBookCommonOptions.upColor: Color of the bids and buys (the "up" side); --success-color by default, --danger-color with colorConvention "red-up"
OrderBookCommonOptions.downColor: Color of the asks and sells (the "down" side); --danger-color by default, --success-color with colorConvention "red-up"
OrderBookCommonOptions.colorConvention: "red-up" swaps the default colors: red bids and buys, green asks and sells (mainland China, Japan, Korea)
OrderBookCommonOptions.pricePrecision: Decimals of the prices; inferred from the data when omitted
OrderBookCommonOptions.sizePrecision: Decimals of the sizes; inferred from the data when omitted
OrderBookCommonOptions.locale: Locale of the numbers (Intl.NumberFormat, compact units such as k or 万) and of the built-in texts (English, Chinese, Japanese, French); the page language (lang attribute of the html element) when omitted
OrderBookCommonOptions.formatPrice: Formats a price (replaces pricePrecision and locale)
OrderBookCommonOptions.formatSize: Formats a size (replaces sizePrecision and locale)
OrderBookCommonOptions.fontFamily: Font of the texts; the theme font when omitted (a monospace font aligns the digits)
OrderBookCommonOptions.fontSize: Font size of the texts, in pixels
OrderBookCommonOptions.ariaLabel: Accessible name of the widget; the localized labels.name when omitted

OrderBookWidgetProps.height: Height of the widget; numbers are pixels
OrderBookWidgetProps.width: Width of the widget; numbers are pixels

OrderBookLabels.bid: Best bid, in the screen reader summary
OrderBookLabels.ask: Best ask, in the screen reader summary
OrderBookLabels.basisPoints: Basis points unit of the spread row
OrderBookLabels.name: Accessible name (when ariaLabel is not set)

OrderBookLevelEvent.sum: Cumulative size from the best level to this one
OrderBookLevelEvent.notional: Cumulative notional (Σ price × size) from the best level to this one

OrderBookSnapshot.bids: Buy levels: [price, size] tuples or { price, size } columns, in any order
OrderBookSnapshot.asks: Sell levels: [price, size] tuples or { price, size } columns, in any order
OrderBookSnapshot.time: Exchange time of the snapshot (ms since epoch); the local clock when omitted

OrderBookDelta.bids: Changed buy levels: the new size of each price, 0 removes the level
OrderBookDelta.asks: Changed sell levels: the new size of each price, 0 removes the level
OrderBookDelta.time: Exchange time of the update (ms since epoch); the local clock when omitted

OrderBookLevelColumns.price: Prices of the levels (typed arrays welcome)
OrderBookLevelColumns.size: Resting size of each level (0 removes the level in a delta)

ladder.title: Order book ladder
ladder.description: Asks above the spread row, bids below, a large order highlighted; clicking a row reports its price and size.

live.title: Live ladder
live.description: Streaming updates flash the changed sizes, the last price moves the spread row; levels grouped by 0.1.

props.options: Other engine options (OrderBookOptions of minerva-design/charts/core: colors, texts, locale, labels…); property only
props.instance: The engine instance (minerva-design/charts/core), null until the element is rendered and connected

events.minerva-hover: A row is hovered; detail: { side, index, price, size, sum, notional, average }, null when the pointer left
events.minerva-level-click: A row was clicked, tapped or activated with Enter; detail: { side, index, price, size, sum, notional, average }

methods.setLastPrice: Price of the spread row (the mid price when null)
methods.applyDeltas: Applies updates (size 0 removes a level); drawn once at the next frame
